purpose: A person's own stream of attention: what they looked at, newest first, recomposed from the agent-private observations on their own node. This recipe is the whole of the ranking, and its CID prints on every page it renders.

omissions_policy.signature: Every observation is unsigned until the signing graduation; the view carries one omission line saying so.
omissions_policy.window: Observations older than the window are not rendered; the view names how many were left out.
omissions_policy.payload: An observation whose payload does not parse renders with zero dwell and depth, and the view names it.
